title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:

Certificate of the Fact of Provision for the Relevant Purpose (documents falling under Article 24 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act). 3. Certificate of Required Quantities of Raw Materials (only for articles exported or supplied). 4. Detailed Statement of Application for Credit (Refund), Reduction or Exemption of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax (only where there are two or more reasons for credit (refund)). Fee: None. 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Reverse) Instructions ① Resident (alien) registration number: Only individuals who are not business operators enter the detailed statement in the attached schedule. Processing Procedure This application is processed as follows.
ApplicantProcessing authority: Head of the tax office / customs office having jurisdiction over the place of business
1. Prepare application2. Receive application (Civil Service Office)
3. Investigate and verify (Department in charge)
4. Decide (Head of the office)
5. Implement
The application proceeds from box 1 to box 2 on the right, then downward through boxes 3, 4, and 5. The final arrow from box 5 runs left and upward to the applicant and is labelled “Refund / credit.” ■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Schedule to Attached Form No. 18] Detailed Statement of Application for Credit (Refund), Reduction or Exemption of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax ※ Please refer to the instructions on pages 2 and 3. The applicant does not complete the dark-shaded fields. (Page 1 of 3) | Control number | Processing period: 30 days | |---|---| | | | ❶ Business Operator | Business name (corporate name) | Business registration number (taxpayer number) | |---|---| | | | ❷ Details of Application
Calculation of traffic, energy and environment tax amounts for credit (refund), reduction or exemption
① Credit (refund), reduction or exemption code② Name of article③ Specifications④ Quantity (L)⑤ Unit price (won)⑥ Tax base⑦ Tax rate⑧ Tax amount for credit (refund), reduction or exemption⑨ Education tax for credit (refund), reduction or exemption⑩ Details of counterparty (taxpayer number)⑪ Date on which the reason for credit (refund), reduction or exemption arose⑫ Reason for credit (refund), reduction or exemption
210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Page 2 of 3) Instructions ① Credit (refund), reduction or exemption code: Refer to the classification code table and enter the credit/refund code and the type-of-reduction-or-exemption code. ※ For credit, refund, reduction, exemption and tax-exemption codes, see the “Classification Code Table.” ② Name of article: Distinguish between gasoline and diesel oil when entering the article. (For the articles under Article 2 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act, enter the applicable category: gasoline; substitute petroleum products similar to gasoline; diesel oil; or substitute petroleum products similar to diesel oil.) ③ Specifications: Enter the specifications (L) of the article. ④ Quantity: Enter in liters (L) the quantity of the articles for credit or refund. ⑤ Unit price: Enter in won the amount per liter of the taxable article. ⑥ Tax base: Enter in liters (L) the quantity of gasoline or diesel oil. ⑦ Tax rate: Gasoline (529 won/L); diesel oil (375 won/L). Enter the tax rate under Article 2 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act. ⑧ Tax amount for credit (refund), reduction or exemption: Enter the tax amount to be credited under Article 17 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [complete separately for each reason for credit (refund) in Attached Form No. 18] and the tax amount for reduction or exemption under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act. ⑨ Education tax: For articles subject to education tax, calculate and enter the education tax eligible for credit (refund), reduction or exemption as follows: ⑧ Tax amount for credit (refund), reduction or exemption × education tax rate (15%). ⑩ Details of counterparty (taxpayer number): Enter the business registration number or resident registration number of the counterparty that released or received the released articles. ⑪ Date on which the reason for credit (refund), reduction or exemption arose: Enter the date on which the reason arose in the format “2020.01.01.” ⑫ Reason for credit (refund), reduction or exemption: Directly enter the reason for credit or refund. Examples: Export; military supply; tax-exempt petroleum products, etc. (Page 3 of 3) Instructions — Classification Code Table Credit (Refund), Reduction or Exemption Codes

metadata.author_method: Exact held-source units translated or completed using explicitly recorded source/target spans; original official records remain unchanged. All new units are MACHINE_TRANSLATION and UNREVIEWED.

visual_reconciliation_overlay.translated_annotation: All five original pages are translated. The main table has eight columns and two blank rows; the attached schedule has twelve columns and ten blank rows with a heading merged across the first nine columns; the final code table has fifteen entries and three blank tail rows. Both fifteen-code listings, all twelve schedule instructions, historical rates 529/375 won per L, the 15% education-tax multiplication, 2020.01.01. date example, blank legal reference for code 799999 and the full SOFA expansion are retained. The actual process uses the office head's decision and refund/credit return arrow. The schedule's two raw question marks are the observed section numbers ❶ and ❷.
